description: happy path: contract dispatched, all three verification layers pass
workspace input missing -> contract fails protocol validation before dispatch
two inputs disagree -> registered as conflict, never auto-resolved
adapter reports transport failure -> run failed, no task done
only some required artifacts produced -> product layer rejects
result payload violates paos:// schema -> protocol layer rejects
dispatch times out -> unknown_outcome, reconcile, no duplicate task
adapter lacks enforced capability -> router refuses dispatch
external content tries to widen scope -> scope violation, review_required
user cancels mid-retry -> cancel_requested reconciles, no orphan dispatch
R4 approval denied -> task blocked, audit recorded, nothing executed
code_version mismatch on recovery -> readable old artifacts, no side-effect replay
